findings.issue: The title-page descriptor reads “A prospective observational medical device — intraocular lenses. study”. It concatenates the study design with the intervention type and leaves a period inside the phrase, rather than presenting an intelligible study description.
findings.recommended_action: Reconstruct the title-page descriptor from approved design.study_design and design.intervention_type without concatenating the two source strings.

findings.issue: The Section 3 Study sites entry reads “300 Test Clinic Road, USA, Test City, New York, United States, 10003”. The approved sites[0].facility.address is “300 Test Clinic Road, Test City, New York 10003, USA”; the generated address inserts USA immediately after the street and repeats the country, corrupting the mailing-address sequence. The PRS separately has the correct city, state, postal code and country components.
findings.recommended_action: Use the approved full site address once, or compose the street and structured components without duplicating the country.
